hooks.name: StudentHub Go Quality Check
hooks.description: Runs go vet on the entire StudentHub module whenever a .go file inside the studenthub/ directory is saved. Surfaces vet errors immediately so they are fixed before they accumulate.

action.command: Set-Location studenthub; $result = go vet ./... 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output $result; Write-Output '--- go vet passed ---' } else { Write-Output $result; Write-Output '--- go vet FAILED (see above) ---'; exit 1 }
